about: Fitted coefficients for LookPipeline's stages. Read by the app (bundle), lumina-render and Tools/parity/lookmath.py. Tools/parity/loop.sh edits `coefficients` and sets `locked` when a stage meets the parity criteria; a human edits everything else. The criteria live in Tools/parity/criteria.json and are never changed by the loop.

rawDevelop.form: CIRAWFilter, Apple's default profile, no auto; scaleFactor for size; draft mode below draftBelowPx; lensShading undoes the lens's corner falloff in linear space with the camera's own VignettingCorrParams, scaled in stops (LookLensShading: 1 is the camera's partial correction; Lightroom's lens profile is 1.3-2.2x that on the sweep); then the base match to Lightroom's Adobe Color (LookMath.baseMatch): a luma midtone curve p + baseLift*p*(1-p) + baseS*p*(1-p)*(p-0.5) in perceptual space, and a colour mix with off-diagonals baseRG … baseBG whose rows sum to 1; last, colour fades toward the pixel's luma near white (baseHiDesat above perceptual baseHiFrom) and in the deepest shadows (baseLoDesat below baseLoBelow)

exposure.form: a scene gain through a sigmoid tone curve, per channel: G·y / (1 + (G − 1)·y/white) with G = 2^(ev * stopsPerUnit); tangent continuation above white and below 0

whiteBalance.form: per-channel scene gains from the mired and tint differences to as-shot, each channel through the tone curve as in exposure (G*y / (1 + (G-1)*y/white)): r: 2^(dM*redPerMired + dTint*redPerTint), g: 2^(-dTint*greenPerTint), b: 2^(-dM*bluePerMired + dTint*bluePerTint); divided by their luma first when preserveLuma is 1

whitesBlacks.form: per channel in perceptual p = x^(1/gamma): p -= (-blacks*blacksPerUnit) * (1-p)^blacksPower; p += whites*whitesPerUnit * p^whitesPower

tone.form: a local exposure through the tone curve, relative to the photo. base = gaussian blur of luma (radiusFraction of the long edge). The photo's anchor (256 px develop): mean A = 2^mean(log2 luma), pushed through exposure; spread = std of log2 luma; bright = share of pixels above L* 80. high H = the 95th percentile of luma, pushed through exposure like A. ps = perceptual(base*(0.18/A)^shadowsAdapt*2^(shadowsHighAdapt*(highCentre-log2 H))), ph = perceptual(base*(0.18/A)^highlightsAdapt*2^(highlightsHighAdapt*(highCentre-log2 H))); G = 2^(shadows*shadowsStopsPerUnit*exp(shadowsBright*(bright-brightCentre) + shadowsSpread*(spread-spreadCentre))*exp(-ps/shadowsTau) + highlights*highlightsStopsPerUnit*exp(highlightsMean*(log2 A-meanCentre) + highlightsSpread*(spread-spreadCentre))*min(1, ph/highlightsKnee)), each strength factor kept in [0.25, 4]; detail (luma/base)^(detailGain-1) re-applied; then per channel G*y / (1 + (G-1)*y/white) as in exposure

contrast.form: two-sided power curve in perceptual space around midpoint with slope a = 2^(contrast*slopePerUnit): below m: m*(p/m)^a, above: 1-(1-m)*((1-p)/(1-m))^a; applied per channel and on luma, mixed by lumaMix

colour.form: Oklab chroma: C *= max(0, 1+saturation*saturationPerUnit) * max(0, 1 + vibrance*perUnit*(1-(1-vibranceFloor)*min(1,C/vibranceChromaMax))*(1-skinProtect*skin(h))) ; perUnit = vibrancePerUnit above 0, vibranceDownPerUnit below; skin(h) = exp(-((h-skinHue)/skinWidth)^2), only for vibrance > 0; bw sets C = 0

clarity.form: q = perceptual(luma), base = gaussian blur of q (radiusFraction of the long edge); q += clarity*amountPerUnit*(q-base)*(1-|2q-1|^midtonePower); rgb scaled by the luma ratio

sharpen.form: unsharp mask with threshold in perceptual luma: hp = q - blur(q, radiusPx * px/refPx); q += sharpen*amountPerUnit*hp*smoothstep(threshold, 2*threshold, |hp|)

vignette.form: gain 2^(vignette*stopsPerUnit*smoothstep(midpoint-feather/2, midpoint+feather/2, r)) with r = distance from the centre over the half diagonal. With a shape (the look's vigs:mid,round,feather,hl off its reset 50,0,50,0; LookMath.VignetteForm, unfitted): the smoothstep's middle is midpoint + (mid-50)/100*midpointRange and its width feather*fea/50; r = (|u*sx|^p + |v*sy|^p)^(1/p) over its value at a corner, u and v in -1..1 across the frame, at position q = clamp(roundAtReset + round*(1 + roundAtReset/100), -100, 100) of the family +100 a circle in pixels (sx:sy = aspect:1, p 2), 0 the frame's ellipse (sx = sy = 1), -100 the frame's rectangle (p = rectPower); a darkening vignette's stops are scaled by 1 - hl/100*P^highlightsPower, P the pixel's perceptual luma in 0..1

outputTransform.form: mapper clamp: clamp to 0..1. mapper sigmoid (LookMath.DisplayMapper; a prototype, measured, not adopted): inset (every primary `inset` of the way to white, turned `rotate` degrees about the grey axis), each channel through a shoulder in log2 around 0.18 (identity up to kneeEV stops above grey; above, L' = kneeEV + H*(1-(1-u)^q) with u = (L-kneeEV)/(maxEV-kneeEV), H = log2(1/0.18)-kneeEV, q = (maxEV-kneeEV)/H: slope 1 at the knee, exactly 1 at maxEV), the middle channel put back between the other two (hueKeep), outset = the inset's inverse, clamp to 0..1. Either way, then: working space to the output space (sRGB preview / export, ProPhoto RGB for parity TIFFs)
